Finance · Settings (approved D9): the shared time list (F2, v1.019 / v1.109) — one question (Off: section 2)

Each box becomes the shared time list: Off, then 11:00 AM–11:00 PM every 5 minutes (146 choices), AM/PM on every time, opening at the chosen time, the same list on phones. Drawn Now and After at PC 1280 × 800, tablet 820 × 1180 (touch), phone 390 × 844 (touch) and 320 wide. Amber outline = what changes. Brown text = the question. No invented wording: every word on screen is today’s; the screen-reader words in section 3 are today’s too. Pictures: images/Finance-DR-F2-Settings.png (sections 1, 3, 4) and images/Finance-DR-F2-Settings-Off.png (section 2, the decision).

1 · Reminder On: the shared time list in every box

What changes (decided: v1.019, v1.109; the list itself is approved, M8)

  • Each of the 14 boxes (7 days × 2 schools) becomes the shared time list (TimeList.jsx) with from="11:00", to="23:00" and offLabel="Off": Off, then 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM every 5 minutes = 146 choices (today: Off + 49, every 15 minutes).
  • AM/PM on every time (as today). The list opens at the chosen time, in the middle, tinted blue, with the 2 px blue ring on the row the arrow keys are on and M8’s thin scroll bar; typing “8” jumps to 8:00 PM, “o” to Off.
  • Phones and tablets get the same list instead of the device’s own picker (v0.51). On touch each time is a 44 px row.
  • While a change is saving, the boxes become readOnly (gray and can’t open — the shared list’s saving look). Today they are only marked aria-disabled while saving.
  • Same place, same size as today’s box (140 px wide; 44 px tall on phones), same table on PC / tablet (D9), one school at a time on phones (D9). Saving, the toast with Undo, “Copy each school’s Monday to Tue–Fri” and all words are unchanged.
  • Old times stay valid: every 15-minute time is also a 5-minute time (migration 0029, live).

Sample data (preview, fake database): Shrewsbury Mon–Fri 8:45 PM, Sat 1:30 PM, Sun Off; Worcester Mon–Fri 9:00 PM, Sat 2:00 PM, Sun Off. The device school is Worcester, so phones show Worcester. The open box is Monday. Pictures are the real preview app with the shared list’s markup and styles drawn in place of the browser boxes; nothing in the app was changed. Today’s browser list can’t be photographed open, so “Now” shows it closed. The Off state is the question in section 2 (its own picture).

2 · Finance F2 · Settings: the one decision — the boxes while the reminder is Off

Today

  • Switch Off → the times are kept but the boxes are disabled: gray background, gray words and arrow (#8A8A85), can’t open, skipped by Tab, heard by screen readers as “dimmed / unavailable”. A truly disabled control is exempt from the 4.5:1 text-contrast rule (WCAG 1.4.3).

What the shared list can do today (checked in TimeList.jsx / Select.jsx)

  • No disabled. Only readOnly (“gray and closed while the dialog saves”): the list won’t open, the box keeps its Tab stop and is heard as “read only”. A read-only box is still an active control, so its words need 4.5:1. Its look: light gray background (#F7F7F5), black words, and on PC the busy cursor (cursor: progress, meant for “saving…”).

Decided 2026-10-29 (rulebook v0.823): option C — a real disabled on the shared list, built by Dashboard core. Options A and B below were rejected; don’t build them.

Option A · readOnly exactly as the shared part draws it

  • + Can be built now; no shared change, no Finance-only look.
  • + Keyboard and screen-reader users can Tab to each box and hear its time (“Monday reminder time at Worcester, 9:00 PM, read only”). Black words: 15:1.
  • − Black words on a nearly white box look usable, on phones especially; tapping does nothing. Only the switch above says why.
  • − On PC the pointer turns into the busy cursor over a box that isn’t busy.
  • − 14 extra Tab stops that can’t be used, where today there are none.

Option B · readOnly + Finance’s own gray words

  • A’s behaviour plus a rule in finance.css on Finance’s wrapper (.fin-time.is-off): words and arrow in --color-text-secondary (#6B6B6B, 4.97:1 on #F7F7F5 — passes 4.5:1), normal cursor. Today’s lighter gray (#8A8A85, 3.2:1) would fail, because the boxes are still active (read only). TimeList and Select are not changed.
  • + Reads as “off” better than A; no busy cursor; can be built now.
  • − Still A’s behaviour: 14 Tab stops, “read only” instead of “unavailable”. Slightly darker gray than today.
  • − A Finance-only look on a shared part — against v1.019’s “one time list everywhere”. It needs your explicit OK as an exception.
  • − It has to reach inside the shared part’s own class names (.sel-field.is-readonly .fa-value, .fa-chevron): if Dashboard core renames them later, Finance’s gray silently disappears.

Option C · a real disabled in the shared part (Dashboard core builds it)

  • A new disabled prop on Select.jsx and TimeList.jsx, built by the Dashboard core session (shared-part changes go there): no Tab stop (tabIndex=-1), aria-disabled="true" (heard as “unavailable”), can’t open, today’s disabled gray (#8A8A85 words and arrow on #F7F7F5, normal cursor). Finance passes disabled={!on}.
  • + Keeps today’s behaviour and look exactly: skipped by Tab, heard as unavailable, gray. Truly disabled, so the lighter gray is allowed (exempt from 1.4.3).
  • + Stays “one time list everywhere”: any section with an unavailable time (or any dropdown) gets the same look; nothing Finance-only to break.
  • − Cost: a shared-part change + Dashboard core’s own review, and you send it there. F2’s Off look waits for it (or F2 ships with A first and switches when C lands).

Recommendation: C

It is the only option that keeps today’s behaviour (no useless Tab stops, “unavailable”) and today’s look without a Finance-only exception, and it is small for Dashboard core. If you want F2 out before that: ship with A (it’s the shared part as approved, nothing to undo) and switch to C when it lands. B is not recommended: it fixes only the look, needs an exception, and breaks silently on a rename.

3 · Screen-reader names (nothing to see; how it would be built)

  • Today each box has an aria-label from T.timeFor(day, school): “Monday reminder time at Shrewsbury”. TimeList takes labelId only; it puts it on aria-labelledby of the box and of its list.
  • Build: next to each box, one visually-hidden span holding exactly T.timeFor(day, school), with an id made unique by React’s useId (e.g. `${id}-${school}-${weekday}`), and labelId pointing to it. Heard: “Monday reminder time at Shrewsbury, 8:45 PM” — today’s words, no new wording. Same on PC, tablet and phones.

4 · What the shared list can’t do (no shared file is changed for F2 itself)

  • No disabled — only readOnly (the decision, separate picture: Option C adds it in Dashboard core).
  • No aria-label — labelId only; solved with one hidden span per box (section 3).
  • No className / width — Finance wraps each list in its own <div class="fin-time"> and sets the 140 px width from finance.css.
  • readOnly’s busy cursor is right while saving (the boxes are readOnly then), wrong for Off (options A/B).
  • Everything else F2 needs is there: from / to, offLabel (Off gives null, the database gets null as today), 5-minute step by default, a saved time off the list still shown.
